faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Consultant Paediatrics recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the PGIMER Consultant Paediatrics recruitment is 28th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant Paediatrics post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Consultant Paediatrics position, candidates must possess an MD in Paediatrics from a recognized medical college, along with three years of relevant experience post-MD. Experience in Telemedicine is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Consultant Paediatrics position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant Paediatrics post is 50 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Consultant Paediatrics role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant Paediatrics post involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview and document verification. Candidates are advised to prepare thoroughly for each stage.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this PGIMER Consultant Paediatrics recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Consultant Paediatrics position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Consultant Paediatrics post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,50,000 per month. This is a fixed remuneration for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the PGIMER Consultant Paediatrics recruitment must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this PGIMER Consultant Paediatrics recruitment is Tele/PGI/26/00038. This number should be used for any future reference or correspondence regarding the application.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Consultant Paediatrics post at PGIMER is on a contractual basis. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the PGIMER located?
faq.answer: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) is located in Chandigarh. The recruitment is for positions within this esteemed medical institution.
